shows.title: Forensic Handwriting Analysis / Psychopomps & the Soul
shows.first_half: Forensic handwriting examiner Sheila Lowe joins guest host Ryan Wrecker (email) to explore the psychology revealed through handwriting and her work on high-profile cases involving O.J. Simpson and JonBenét Ramsey. She’ll also share what she has learned about life beyond Earth following the murder of her daughter. Followed by psychotherapist and author Tiffany Lazic, who explores what ancient wisdom traditions teach us about death and the fascinating world of psychopomps, the legendary guides of souls.
shows.second_half: From 6-10pm PT, Art Bell: Somewhere in Time returns to 8/15/97, when publisher Kathy Keeton discussed alternative cancer treatments.

shows.title: Protecting Wild Horses / UAP Revelations
shows.guests: Jerry Reynoldson, Dina Titus, Jonathan Caplan
shows.first_half: First Half: Advocate Jerry Reynoldson and Congresswoman Dina Titus join George Knapp to discuss their latest efforts to protect America’s wild horses and burros. They'll provide an update on reform efforts, growing congressional support for humane alternatives, and what the public can do to help.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author, King's Counsel, and UAP researcher Jonathan Caplan will discuss decades of research into UFOs, examining evidence, witness testimony, and claims of government secrecy. He'll share what led him to question the official narrative and explore what the growing public and congressional interest in UAPs may mean going forward.

shows.title: Akashic Records & Evolution / Paranormal Research
shows.first_half: First Half: Author and teacher Bill Foss explores the Akashic Records, the soul's evolution, and the stages of spiritual development. He’ll share practical ways to access the records, enhance psychic abilities, and discover a deeper life purpose. He’ll also examine how reconnecting with universal energy can inspire personal transformation.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author and paranormal researcher Larry Flaxman shares cases from his decades of paranormal research, including investigations at the historic Crescent Hotel. He’ll explore EVP recordings, brain activity at the moment of death, and theories of quantum immortality and entanglement.

shows.title: Natural Remedies / Haunted America
shows.first_half: First Half: Pharmacist Ben Fuchs discusses wellness and the role of nutritional supplementation alongside conventional medicine, offering insights into how we can achieve optimal health.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Author, paranormal researcher, and paramedic Richard Estep delves into the haunted history of the United States, exploring 250 years of ghost stories, legends, and hauntings. From the battlefields of the American Revolution and the phantom defenders of the Alamo to the spirits associated with the RMS Queen Mary, he’ll examine some of the nation’s most enduring supernatural tales.

shows.title: Spirit Communication Techniques / Mysteries of Black Holes
shows.first_half: First Half: Psychic medium and paranormal researcher Loren Purcell shares practical approaches to communicating with spirits and investigating the paranormal. She’ll explore how intuition and tools such as dowsing rods, pendulums, and Tarot can aid investigations, along with techniques for spiritual protection.
shows.second_half: Second Half: Astrophysicist and author Heino Falcke explores black holes and why they remain one of science’s greatest frontiers. He’ll explain their role in the universe's evolution, the conditions that made life possible, and the profound unanswered questions about what lies beyond black holes and the Big Bang.

shows.title: Houdini & Magic / Lizzie Borden Case
shows.first_half: First Half: President of Potter & Potter Auctions, Gabe Fajuri will discuss the legacy of Harry Houdini, the mysteries surrounding his death, and Houdini’s influence on the world of magic. He'll also preview the special anniversary auction at the Magic Castle in Hollywood on Halloween, featuring Houdini-related artifacts.
shows.second_half: Second Half: C2C's investigative reporter Cheryll Jones presents her recorded interview with former homicide detective Jason White exploring the infamous 1892 Lizzie Borden case, in which Borden was accused of the axe murders of her father and stepmother. Jason will join George and Cheryll live during the final hour.

shows.title: Paranormal Strangeness / Ghost-to-Ghost 2026
shows.first_half: Paranormal investigator, author, and podcast host Joshua P. Warren will discuss new strategies for dealing with paranormal entities and reveal why Halloween has long been considered a unique time for heightened supernatural activity. Exploring the mysteries of interdimensional portals, energy anomalies, and spirit encounters, Warren will offer guidance for navigating paranormal phenomena. Then, join us for our annual Ghost-to-Ghost show and call in with your scariest, creepiest ghost story.
